# Basic Packaging Workflowsvg image

Relevant source files

- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md)

- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml)

## Purpose and Scopesvg image

This page provides a step-by-step guide for the fundamental Contexter workflow: converting a project directory into a single context file (packaging) and rebuilding the project from that file (reconstruction). This bidirectional process enables project portability, simple backups, and sharing projects via text-based mediums.

For conceptual background on context files and their formats, see [Context Files](/ray0404/Contexter/3.1-context-files). For patch-based updates to existing context files, see [Version Control with Patches](/ray0404/Contexter/4.3-version-control-with-patches). For integrating AI-generated code, see [AI Integration Workflow](/ray0404/Contexter/4.2-ai-integration-workflow).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md1-37](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L1-L37)

---

## Overview of the Basic Workflowsvg image

The basic packaging workflow consists of two primary operations that form a complete round-trip:

1. **Packaging (Build)**: Aggregate a project directory into a single context file
2. **Reconstruction (Rebuild)**: Extract the context file back into a directory structure

**Diagram: Basic Packaging Round-Trip Workflow**

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md22-37](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L22-L37) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py1-74](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L1-L74)

## Step 1: Packaging a Project Directorysvg image

### Command Syntaxsvg image

The `buildcontext` command creates a Markdown context file from one or more directory or file paths:

| Parameter | Description | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `output_file` | Path to the output Markdown file (e.g., `project.md`) | Yes |
| `paths` | One or more directories or files to include | Yes |
| `--exclude` | Additional exclusion patterns (can be specified multiple times) | No |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py51-55](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L51-L55)

### Basic Examplesvg image

Package a single project directory:

This command will:

1. Scan `./my_project` directory recursively
2. Apply default exclusion patterns (see [Exclusion Patterns](/ray0404/Contexter/3.4-exclusion-patterns))
3. Generate a directory tree structure
4. Extract text file contents with syntax highlighting markers
5. Write everything to `my_project_context.md`

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py60-71](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L60-L71) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md24](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L24-L24)

Package multiple directories or specific files:

This packages:

- Entire `./src` directory

- Single file `./config.yaml`
- Excludes any files matching `*.log` pattern

### Console Output During Packagingsvg image

The `buildcontext` command provides visual feedback during execution:

| Symbol | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 📂 | Processing directory | `📂 Processing directory: ./src` |
| ✅ | Successfully processed file | `✅ Processed: ./src/main.py` |
| ⚫ | Skipped binary file | `⚫ Skipping (binary): ./assets/logo.png` |
| ❌ | Error reading file | `❌ Error reading file ./bad.txt: [error]` |
| ⚠️ | Path not found | `⚠️ Warning: Path not found, skipping: ./missing` |
| 🎉 | Success completion | `🎉 Success! All paths processed into 'output.md'.` |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py20-71](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L20-L71)

## Step 2: Understanding the Generated Context Filesvg image

### Context File Structuresvg image

A generated Markdown context file has three main sections:

1. **Directory Structure Section** (optional, only for directories)
2. **File Content Sections** (one per file)
3. **Binary File Markers** (for skipped binary files)

**Diagram: Context File Internal Structure**

### Example Context File Contentsvg image

my\_project/
├── src/
│ ├── main.py
│ └── utils.py
└── README.md

```px-2
--- FILE: my_project/src/main.py ---

````python
def main():
    print("Hello, World!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

--- FILE: my\_project/src/utils.py ---

--- FILE: my\_project/README.md ---

--- SKIPPED (BINARY): my\_project/logo.png ---

```px-2
**Sources:** <FileRef file-url="https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L25-L45" min=25 max=45 file-path="context_builder.py">Hii</FileRef>

### Code Fence Format

Each file's content is wrapped in a code fence with a language identifier:

| Element | Description | Source |
|---------|-------------|--------|
| Opening fence | `````{lang}` where `{lang}` is detected from file extension | <FileRef file-url="https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L45-L45" min=45  file-path="context_builder.py">Hii</FileRef> |
| Content | Raw file content with `.strip()` applied | <FileRef file-url="https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L45-L45" min=45  file-path="context_builder.py">Hii</FileRef> |
| Closing fence | ```` ` | <FileRef file-url="https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L45-L45" min=45  file-path="context_builder.py">Hii</FileRef> |

The language identifier is determined by `get_language_from_path()` from `contexter_utils.py` and enables syntax highlighting when viewing the context file.

**Sources:** <FileRef file-url="https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L43-L45" min=43 max=45 file-path="context_builder.py">Hii</FileRef> <FileRef file-url="https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L8-L8" min=8  file-path="context_builder.py">Hii</FileRef>

## Step 3: Reconstructing a Project

### Command Syntax

The `reconstructor` command rebuilds a directory structure from a Markdown context file:

```bash
reconstructor <context_file.md> <output_directory>
```

| Parameter | Description | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `context_file` | Path to the Markdown context file (e.g., `project.md`) | Yes |
| `output_directory` | Path where the project will be reconstructed | Yes |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md25](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L25-L25)

### Basic Examplesvg image

Reconstruct a project from a context file:

This command will:

1. Parse `my_project_context.md` to extract file paths and contents
2. Create the `./restored_project` directory if it doesn't exist
3. Recreate the directory structure
4. Write each file with its original content
5. Skip binary file markers (they are informational only)

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md25](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L25-L25)

### Reconstruction Process Flowsvg image

**Diagram: reconstructor Execution Flow**

The reconstruction logic is implemented in the `reconstructor.py` module, which uses utility functions from `contexter_utils.py` to parse the context file format and extract file information.

## Step 4: Verifying the Resultsvg image

### Directory Comparisonsvg image

After reconstruction, verify that the rebuilt project matches the original:

### Expected Outcomessvg image

| File Type | Packaging Behavior | Reconstruction Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text files | Included with content | Restored exactly |
| Binary files | Marked as `SKIPPED (BINARY)` | Not reconstructed (marker only) |
| Excluded files | Not included | Not reconstructed |
| Empty directories | Not explicitly tracked | May not be recreated |
| Symlinks | May be followed or skipped | Not preserved as symlinks |

### Limitations to Considersvg image

1. **Binary Files**: Binary files are detected and skipped during packaging, so they will not be present in reconstructed projects
2. **File Permissions**: Unix file permissions (executable bits, etc.) are not preserved
3. **Timestamps**: File modification/creation times are not preserved
4. **Empty Directories**: Directories containing only excluded files may not be recreated
5. **Symlinks**: Symbolic links may not be preserved depending on OS

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py36-38](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L36-L38)

## Common Options and Customizationsvg image

### Custom Exclusion Patternssvg image

Add patterns to exclude specific files or directories beyond the defaults:

The `--exclude` flag can be specified multiple times. Each pattern follows shell glob syntax (`*`, `?`, `[...]`).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py54-57](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L54-L57)

### Default Exclusion Patternssvg image

The system applies default exclusions automatically (defined in `contexter_utils.py` as `DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS`). Common defaults include:

- Version control: `.git`, `.svn`, `.hg`
- Dependencies: `node_modules`, `venv`, `env`
- Build artifacts: `__pycache__`, `*.pyc`, `dist`, `build`
- IDE files: `.vscode`, `.idea`, `.DS_Store`

For the complete list and details on customizing exclusions, see [Exclusion Patterns](/ray0404/Contexter/3.4-exclusion-patterns).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py8-57](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L8-L57)

### Packaging Specific Files Onlysvg image

To package specific files without entire directories:

This approach provides fine-grained control over what gets included in the context file.
